text:
Small smoke particles suspended in air are viewed through a microscope.
The smoke particles move randomly.
What does this show?
A
The air consists of fast-moving molecules.
B
The pressure of the air is increasing.
C
There are convection currents in the air.
D
The temperature of the air is increasing.

options.label: A
options.text: The air consists of fast-moving molecules.

options.label: B
options.text: The pressure of the air is increasing.

options.label: C
options.text: There are convection currents in the air.

options.label: D
options.text: The temperature of the air is increasing.
